instruction: Export the current VLC frame as an image file named 'vlc_screen.png' and place it on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing video screenshot and saving as 'vlc_screen.png' on Desktop. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) valid PNG, (3) size 10KB-50MB. State-based evaluation.
